name: refute_counters_only_the_targeted_spell_and_the_discard_is_the_casters_free_choice
notes: Printed: 'Counter target spell. Draw a card, then discard a card.' Seat 0 casts Aegis Turtle ({U}) and, on top of it, Giant Growth ({G}) at its own Bear, both waiting on the stack. Seat 1 casts Refute at the LOWER spell, Aegis Turtle: only that spell is countered (it goes to its owner's graveyard and never enters). Refute resolves first, then Giant Growth resolves normally (the Bear is 5/5). Seat 1 draws one card (Drawn) and discards one of its choice: it discards Spare One, so the drawn card stays in its hand: hand = Spare Two + Drawn (2), graveyard = Refute + Spare One. Seat 0 draws and discards nothing.
